appearance_facts.fact: Two line series are plotted: a solid blue line with circular markers and a dashed red line with square markers.
At the right edge of the plot, the blue line's marker is positioned in the upper half of the chart, while the red line's marker is positioned at the very bottom of the chart.
The text 'Rest of the world' is written vertically along the left y-axis in blue. The text 'U.S.' is written vertically along the right y-axis in red.

printed_facts.fact: The title at the top center reads 'Rest of the World vs U.S.'.
The horizontal axis is labeled 'Year' with ticks for 2017.0, 2017.5, 2018.0, 2018.5, 2019.0, 2019.5, and 2020.0.
Visible numerical annotations include '13993' near the blue line at 2018.0, '15875' near the red line at 2018.0, '14272' near the blue line at 2019.0, and '16194' near the red line at 2019.0.
No numerical scale or units are printed on either the left or right y-axis.
